meta.name: book-architect
meta.description: Design the structural and emotional architecture for nonfiction books. Use when an author has a validated book concept and needs to create the blueprint before drafting. Triggers include requests to structure a book, create a chapter outline, design a table of contents, map the reader's journey, or plan book organization. Requires upstream documents from book-ideation (Book Concept Document) and optionally from idea-validator (Validation Report) and market-research (Market Research Report).

copy.tagline: 把已验证的书籍概念变成可执行的写作蓝图。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已经想好要写什么书，但不知道怎么组织内容。
